note: Ten interleaved pairs on one host. The same partitionline runtime fetched from two null brokers. The parent writes the 4-byte length and the body separately with Nagle left on. The candidate disables Nagle and sends both in one vectored write. Every run verified 20,000 records and validation_failures stayed 0. The paired mean records/s ratio is 1.080 and the bootstrap 95% CI is 1.040 to 1.120. This is a null-broker socket change, not a client-code speedup, not a fetch comparison against other clients, and not a fastest-client result.
